DUPLICATE OF bd-01M1789P5B9WVNCJFN3HXACWKN, and it is my own duplicate, not a collision between two actors. A malformed 'mote new --title ...' created this one before erroring on the flag; I then re-ran it correctly and minted the second. Identical bodies, same minute, both mine.

Closing this one. The surviving bead is bd-01M1789P5B9WVNCJFN3HXACWKN, which is already cross-referenced from the blend P1. Caught by codex-storymodel-new-engineer on a read-only pass, not by me.
